import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys
B=json.load(open('corpus-bindings.json'));P={r['id']:r for r in B['rows']}
L=json.load(open('literals.json'))
U='NOT REVIEWED; author-only'
def G(disp,src,ord_,prior,nov,sig,gap,formal='NOT RUN; none dispatched',qual=False):
    return dict(disposition=disp,source_gate=src,ordinary_gate=ord_,prior_gate=prior,novelty_gate=nov,significance_gate=sig,formal_gate=formal,independent_gate=U,acceptance_gate='NOT ACCEPTED; root alone adjudicates; credit 0',exact_gap_or_note=gap,qualified_survivor=qual,credit=0)
UNREAD='PRIMARY BODY UNREAD; literal review only'
BH='Exact ID/source history scan: no matching record'
NQ='NOT QUALIFIED; no worldwide claim'
NS='NOT ASSESSED; no endpoint'
R={}
R[344875]=G('AUTHOR_COMPLETE_NEGATION_ALL_K4_PLUS_EXACT_CONSTANT_SIGNIFICANCE_CONTESTED','arXiv:1912.05775v2 full text read including Conj 5.1, Thms 5.1-5.3 and proofs; listing shows v1,v2; final/correction status not established','Author-complete: Lemmas 1-3, AM-GM, profiles; beta_k<kappa_k for all k>=4. See FULLCANDIDATE.md','Exact history none; two bounded searches found no refutation or exact constant; no specific unread claimant identified',NQ,'CONTESTED: serious routine-extension/optimization objection, FULLCANDIDATE section 6; recommend independent adversarial qualification','No gap in author argument; independent checks listed in FULLCANDIDATE section 8','NOT RUN; dormant plan only, k=4 endpoint, finite graph, feasible')
R[330067]=G('REFUTED_VIA_CLASSICAL_COVERING_ARRAY_LIMIT_RECOMMEND_ROUTINE_ZERO','arXiv:1503.02380v1 Conj 5 and Section 3 read; 1503.08876v1 Theorem 2 read as printed; original GKV body unread','Complete bridge scc<=t*CAN(2,t,d); also trivial d=1 failure','Classical limit d(2,v)=v/2 attributed via printed statement',NQ,'Recommend EXCLUDE: one-step application of classical theorem; d=1 is a boundary correction','True order with partial cliques unpaid; elementary o(d^2) construction attempts failed')
R[339249]=G('CLAUSE_1_REFUTED_UNDER_GNP_HALF_CLAUSE_2_UNPAID_RECOMMEND_ZERO','arXiv:1805.05483 Def 4.1, Section 7-8 passages, Conj 8.1 read','Clause (1) negation proved with attributed norm bound; clause (2) open here',BH,NQ,'Recommend zero: routine spectral argument, probable source slip; model reading "uniform random graph" assumed G(n,1/2)','Clause (2) needs uniform all-vertex lower bound over tangle-free neighbourhoods')
R[364797]=G('SOURCE_OWN_PUBLIC_ZERO','arXiv:2409.10129v1 Theorems 1.7,1.8 and Remark 2 statements read; proof body not audited','No new proof; source confirms Conj 1.5 at r=2','Exact public result in the assigned source','Public','Zero: public','None required')
R[330915]=G('PARK_PRECISE_GAP','arXiv:1507.04169v2 Section 1 and conjecture read','Offline feasibility and rate-balance identification re-derived; conjecture not proved',BH,NQ,NS,'Exponential-order control of online value and endgame term; steering lemma fails at rate order s')
R[328539]=G('PARK_PRECISE_GAP','arXiv:1408.1940v1 definitions and Conj 2.11 read','Necessary covering relation only',BH,NQ,NS,'Need every core element below omega in S(A); no hand counterexample; follow-up literature unread')
R[373109]=G('PARK_PRECISE_GAP','arXiv:2602.11773 definitions and Conj 2 read; literal not trivial','Lexicographic product idea fails',BH,NQ,NS,'Lower bound on backedge clique across interleaved fibres; only additive growth obtained')
R[365985]=G('PARK_PRECISE_GAP',UNREAD,'Gluing, monotonicity, divisor bound; Fekete fails borderline',BH+'; sibling 365982 differs',NQ,NS,'Need injective or low-collision gluing with o(n) overhead')
R[345483]=G('PARK_LOWER_HALF_ONLY',UNREAD,'Ring of parallel paths gives lower bound; upper bound unpaid',BH+'; sibling 345481 differs',NQ,NS,'Upper bound needs flap-type planar structure theorem; no helper credit')
notes={345149:'All large groups and index-2 subgroups: needs a group-classification-scale asymptotic argument; no mechanism attempted beyond literal.',
324028:'Exact n-2 cycle-free transversal for all n is at least as hard as near-full transversal results; small-n refutation not attempted (no enumeration allowed).',
371954:'Implies Gyarfas-Sumner for every forest, including open cases such as P5 polynomial chi-boundedness; flagship.',
354845:'Stochastic approximation on hypercubes and tori for all K>=3; no mechanism; related coexistence on other graphs noted only from the literal.',
347828:'Every rational exponent with a single H; sibling history 348816-source gap concerned a different target; no construction attempted.',
334450:'Open beyond small d by my recollection (unverified); small-beta cumulant signs are consistent, proving nothing.',
328248:'q-colourings of d-regular graphs, q>=3; literal itself says open; no mechanism.',
328573:'All trees; no spectral or arithmetic mechanism attempted beyond literal.',
380420:'Speed gap for every hereditary tournament property; literal text carries extraction damage (cmathcal, calpha); no mechanism.',
368882:'Weil gives only about half of log_r N for shattering; the upper half is beyond Weil-range tools.',
348815:'Full-range analytic flagman in tournament densities; literal says known on [1/72,1/8]; no mechanism.'}
for k,v in notes.items():
    R[k]=G('PARK_AFTER_LITERAL_ONLY',UNREAD,'No full route',BH if k not in (334450,328248,371954,348815) else BH+'; sibling records from same source are different targets',NQ,NS,v)
ids=B['ids'];assert set(ids)==set(R) and len(ids)==20
out={'lane':'expanded-corpus-r532','model':'claude-opus-5-5','credit':0,'qualified_survivors_claimed':0,'results':{}}
for i in ids:
    e=dict(R[i]);e['literal_statement']=L[str(i)]['statement'];e['literal_gate']='FULL LITERAL READ; hash binding includes trailing newline'
    e['provenance']=P[i];out['results'][str(i)]=e
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','results.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False),text=True,capture_output=True);print(w.stdout,w.stderr)
print(len(out['results']),all(out['results'][str(i)]['provenance']['has_trailing_newline'] for i in ids))
sys.exit(w.returncode)
